title: A new species of mantis shrimp (Stomatopoda: Tetrasquillidae) from the Eocene (Ypresian) London Clay of Kent, England
content:
Abstract
A new species of stomatopod, Heterosquilla tankertonensis, is described from the Eocene (Ypresian) London Clay, of Kent, England. This taxon represents the first known fossilized evidence of the family Tetrasquillidae on record to date. Heterosquilla tankertonensis sp. nov. is the second stomatopod described from the London Clay formation.
